author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Shared Custody, a co-op adventure game developed by EAT PANT. Players will embody demons that have assumed the positions of legal guardians to a Sprog who happens to be the next in line for the throne. Keep the Sprog happy and alive while reaching the Unholy Gates at all costs. Shared Custody is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest Dead by Daylight trailer for the asymmetrical multiplayer horror game to see what to expect with the return of the Hallowed Blight collection, which brings very rare outfits for Jason, The Houndmaster, and The Knight.
title: Dead by Daylight - Official Hallowed Blight Collection Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Signal Veil, a psychological survival horror game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will assume the role of Aki after she discovers that her old mother's phone wields the ability to detect supernatural entities. Expose their essence and purge them forever in Signal Veil, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Signal Veil - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Update 0.5 Overview Video for Gray Zone Warfare, a PvE tactical first-person extraction shooter developed by Madfinger Games. Players can get a look at what's in store with the latest update, packed with new locations to fight in, customization options, HDR support, and more. Update 0.5 for Gray Zone Warfare launches on October 22 for PC (Steam).
title: Gray Zone Warfare - Official Update 0.5 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay and features, like the level editor, in this latest Grip 2: Combat Racing Evolved trailer for this upcoming fast and futuristic combat racing game sequel with rocket-powered, flippable vehicles. Race with unique movement tech and use powerful weapons and abilities to beat your opponents to the finish line. Grip 2 will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Grip 2: Combat Racing Evolved - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into what to expect from the free Q Trials update for Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown in this latest trailer for the strategy game. The Q Trials is a new roguelite mode. Overseen by the omnipotent being Q, the Q Trials is built around freedom and replayability. The new mode challenges players to embark on a series of increasingly difficult runs through the Delta Quadrant, shaped by procedural events and random sector goals, creating a unique experience with every run. Extensive customization options allow players to experiment with crew assignments and unconventional strategies, including promoting Harry Kim to Captain.

Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown's free Q Trials update is out now, alongside the Equinox DLC, on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown - Official Q Trials Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Elta: Defy All Gods, a third-person action-adventure platformer developed by Afterburner Studios. Players must master the ancient martial arts, overcome platforming challenges, and embody a powerful warrior monk on a quest to locate their lost dragon-god. Elta: Defy All Gods is launching on February 2 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Elta: Defy All Gods - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for For Mind, a third-person psychological horror zombie game developed by NextGenium. Players will fight through an underwater facility to take on the infected with an array of weapons, abilities, and more. For Mind is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: For Mind - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Ravenous Greed, an arcade pixel-based game developed by Lillymo Games. Players will embody a man trapped in the body of a raven in search of precious wealth to restore his human body. Ravenous Greed is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Ravenous Greed - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Angstrom Levy is about to bring a multiverse of rage. Watch the Invincible Angstrom Levy gameplay trailer for the fighting game to see this character in action. Angstrom is the third fighter included in the Year 1 Character Pass. Invincible VS is available now on Xbox X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). Angstrom will be available when Season 2 of Invincible VS arrives on October 13, 2026.
title: Invincible VS - Official Angstrom Levy Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Grave Seasons, a narrative-driven farming simulation game developed by Perfect Garbage. Players will tend to their farm, seeking peace as an escaped convict when a supernatural serial killer strolls into town. Investigate the townsfolk and seek the truth behind the killer of Ashenridge. Grave Seasons is launching on March 9, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Grave Seasons - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition, the definitive edition of the hit third-person action-adventure game developed by Sucker Punch. Players can gain access to new content with the Echoes of Sekigahara DLC, a new story expansion, and Most Wanted, a combat survival mode. Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
What if you could control your minions? Lead your soldiers, deploy powerful Battleworks, and wage war on a massive scale. Check out gameplay from March of Giants in this latest trailer for the upcoming free-to-play 4v4 MOBA where you lead an army, not just a hero. The new trailer showcases your objectives as you capture objectives, convert soldiers, breach bastions, and much more. March of Giants will be available on PC. The Pioneer Playtest runs on Steam from October 7 to October 18, 2026.

In March of Giants, play as a towering Giant, rally hundreds of Soldiers, and deploy Battleworks that turn familiar lanes into shifting front lines. Master your abilities, lead your army, reshape the battlefield, and take your team to victory.
title: March of Giants - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Date Trailer for Void/Breaker, a first-person action roguelite shooter developed by Stubby Games. Players will take on the endless cycle of violence against a malicious AI. Break free from the system in Void/Breaker, launching on November 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Void/Breaker - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this all new look at the New Beginnings update coming to Masters of Albion, Peter Molyneux's latest entry into the God Game genre from 22Cans. The New Beginnings update brings better performance and fixes, changes to Night mode, a revamped Arcadium, improved jobs system, and so much more! 
The New Beginnings update is live in Masters of Albion right now on PC (Steam).
title: Masters of Albion - Official New Beginnings Update Trailer

description: Don't miss the Anniversary Update 2 Launch Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, the hit third-person action co-op shooter developed by Saber Interactive. Players can now check out all-new content, with a new Chaos Siege Mode, a Crucible System, new weapons and armor, and more to interact with in Anniversary Update 2. The Anniversary Update 2 for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Official Anniversary Update 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo release trailer for KOLUN, a first-person simulation game where you play as WORKER 1331. Your job is simple: work. Pull the handle, split stumps into logs, load them onto a cart, earn Tickets and use them to upgrade your equipment. As you progress, you can make the wood-processing process faster and more efficient. The game also features physics-based interactions and a dark atmospheric setting. Use the workplace computer, study the instructions, read rare messages, and try to understand what is happening beyond your workplace. KOLUN is coming in 2026 for PC (Steam), with a demo available right now!
title: KOLUN - Official Demo Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Split Screen Gameplay Trailer for BeamNG.drive, the hit driving simulation game developed by BeamNG. Take a look at the upcoming Split Screen mode for local play on PS5. Split Screen launches in BeamNG.drive on October 19 for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: BeamNG.drive - Official Split Screen Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step right up, Curators! Watch the latest Two Point Museum trailer for this strategy sim game to see what to expect from Update 12.0, where you can play the first act of the Rides & Relics expansion for free ahead of its launch next week, including a new museum: Riquetti Gardens, five points of interest from the new expedition map, and more. Update 12.0 for Two Point Museum is available now on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). The update is also coming to Nintendo Switch 2.

From the trailer's official description: "Take on the role of Funfair Expert, and prepare to reopen the gates of Two Point County’s once-legendary amusement park after a decades-long hiatus. For years, the site at Riquetti Gardens has sat dark, rusty and guest-less - and there’s nothing amusing about that, hm?"
title: Two Point Museum - Official Update 12.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: RetroSpace is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Check out the RetroSpace launch trailer for this Disco-punk space horror game. The new trailer showcases gameplay, story, and setting. In RetroSpace, you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!
title: RetroSpace - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Mobile Release Date Trailer for Sifu, a third-person action-adventure game developed by Sloclap. Players will fight enemies and age themselves by surviving level after level, with bosses to dispatch and a score to run up along the way. Sifu is launching on October 12 for iOS and Android.
title: Sifu - Official Mobile Release Date Trailer

description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Gears of War: E-Day, the latest installment in the third-person action shooter franchise developed by The Coalition. Fight for survival in Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago's first fight in Gears of War: E-Day, launching on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam), with early access available now through pre-ordering the Premium Edition.
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Official Launch Trailer

title: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered - Official Launch Trailer

description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Soul Hunter, a co-op psychological horror game developed by CGI Lab Games. Players will embody a paranormal research team to prove that the spirit world exists. Use a camera to fend off evil spirits, acquire buffs, and stay sane through it all. Soul Hunter is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Soul Hunter - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Explore Orsterra in Octopath Traveler 1 and Solistia in Octopath Traveler 2, and get another peek at the adventures in this trailer for the Octopath Traveler RPG series. Octopath Traveler 1 and Octopath Traveler 2 are available now on Nintendo Switch 2, with improved resolution and framerate. 

The Octopath Traveler series is an RPG series which features HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG.

Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take.
Embark on an adventure all your own.
title: Octopath Traveler 1 and Octopath Traveler 2 - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Window Trailer for Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered, a remaster of the hit third-person action-adventure horror game developed by Stormind Games. Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered - Official Release Window Trailer

description: Take a look at the PC Launch Trailer for Zero Parades: Director’s Cut, an espionage RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players will endure the trials and tribulations of a single operative on one final mission. The latest update is packed with more material, revisions, improvements, and more. Zero Parades: Director’s Cut is available now on PC (Steam), with a release on November 3 for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Zero Parades: Director’s Cut - Official PC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the True2Track Water Dynamics Trailer for Project Motor Racing, the hit racing simulation series developed by Giants Software. Players can get an overview of the water physics with the game's True2Track system, which allows water to behave realistically in intense weather. Race through the rain in Project Motor Racing, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Project Motor Racing - Official True2Track Water Dynamics Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the story trailer for Europa Universalis 5: Across The Pillars, the first Chronicle Pack for the real-time strategy game. The Across The Pillars Chronicle Pack for Europa Universalis 5 will be available on PC on October 28, 2026.

In Across The Pillars, shape the future of Iberia and North Africa. Compete for dominion across the Western Mediterranean and beyond as Castile, Morocco or Granada. Contest the Straits of Gibraltar, embark on unique Expeditions, navigate the future of the Iberian Union, and lead your nation into a Golden Century of power and exploration.

Will you follow history and win a Castilian victory at the Battle of Río Salado like Alfonso XI? Or will you defy the odds as Abu al-Hasan Ali of Morocco or Yusuf I of Granada and re-assert control over the straight.

Whoever wins will embark on a Golden Century of Art and Exploration into a wider world, that will bring prestige, riches and enemies like never before!

What story will your ambition unfold?
title: Europa Universalis 5: Across The Pillars - Official Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out action-packed gameplay from Bloody Hell 2 in this trailer for the upcoming isometric hack-n-smasher, filled to the brim with metroidvania-style exploration, bullet-hell combat, and some very spicy soulslite elements. Bloody Hell 2 will be available on PC in Q1 2027.
title: Bloody Hell 2 - Official Trailer

description: Take a look at the Extended Operations Free DLC Launch Trailer for 007 First Light, a third-person action-adventure game developed by IO Interactive. Players will take on new content as part of the Extended Operations DLC, including new missions, Photo Mode, New Game+, new weapons, outfits, and the Valhalla Protocol. The Extended Operations Free DLC is available now for 007 First Light on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: 007 First Light - Official Extended Operations Free DLC Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your first look at the Grave Mistakes announcement trailer for this upcoming co-op horror comedy game for up to 4 players from developer Happy Volcano. Grave Mistakes is about running the local funeral home. You'll have to replace body parts with similar-looking items (a head is basically a basketball?) to not raise suspicion from grieving families. Grandma’s dinner has to come from somewhere.


Grave Mistakes will be available on PC via Steam in November 2026. You can sign up for the playtest on Steam if you're interested.
title: Grave Mistakes - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Gaia Crisis, a 2D action horror game developed by Invert Mouse Games. Players will embody the world's last hope, Charlotte, to solve puzzles, take on enemies, and make use of her divine powers against forces seeking to bring death to the world. Gaia Crisis is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching in January 2027.
title: Gaia Crisis - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take another look at the world of The Regreening in this latest trailer for the upcoming cozy simulation game about restoring nature in a soilpunk fairytale. The new trailer showcases what you can expect, including new maps, new stories, and new features. The Regreening will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

In The Regreening, grow plants to create living ecosystems, become friends with ancient spirits, make your own upcycling hub, and hug ALL the animals! Can you transform this deserted world into a joyful home again?
title: The Regreening - Official Demo Launch Trailer

description:
Check out the gameplay trailer for Fortnitemares 2026, the yearly halloween event inside of Fortnite. With several familiar faces, there are plenty of new characters getting ready to board the battle-bus and drop into your Fortnitemare! 
Fortnitemares 2026 is live now in Fortnite!
title: Fortnite - Official "Fortnitemares 2026" Gameplay Trailer

description:
Check out this trailer for the Demo for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, the latest entry in the long-running Metroid-Vania series developed by Evil Empire! 
Sporting a striking art-style and fast paced combat, you play Rose Belmont, a descendant of the legendary Belmont clan as she hunts the forces of the night! Play the demo today and bring your save data into the full release when Castlevania: Belmont's Curse launches on October 15th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Official Demo Trailer

description: Check out what's new in the just-released free Ali Al Muntar expansion for WW1 Gallipoli, the popular large-scale multiplayer first-person shooter set during the first Great War. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065940/Gallipoli/
